en.t: The Akashi Novice said, "How could I dare refuse!

units.source_text: 公子要听，只管吩咐，我叫她到尊前来弹奏就是了。

en.t: If you wish to hear her, my lord, you need only command it, and I shall have her come before you and play.

units.source_text: 在古昔，‘商人妇’弹琵琶也曾感动贵人呢。

en.t: In ancient times, even the lute playing of the 'merchant's wife' once moved a nobleman.

units.source_text: 讲到弹琵琶，真能弹出妙音的人，在古代也不易多得。

en.t: As for playing the biwa, people who could truly draw wondrous sounds from it were not easy to find even in antiquity.

units.source_text: 我那小女却一上手就流畅，高深的曲调也能微妙地表演，不知道她是怎样学得的。

en.t: Yet my young daughter plays smoothly as soon as she takes it up, and she can perform even profound melodies with subtle feeling; I do not know how she learned it.

units.source_text: 让她处在这涛声咆哮的地方，实在怪可怜的。

en.t: To leave her in this place where the waves roar is truly rather pitiful.

units.source_text: 不过每当心思郁结的时候，有这个女儿也可聊以慰情。”

en.t: Still, whenever my heart is weighed down, having this daughter gives me some small comfort."

units.source_text: 话中含有风趣，源氏公子颇感兴味，便把手头的筝推过去请明石道人弹奏。

en.t: His words had a graceful wit, and Prince Genji was much intrigued, so he pushed the koto at hand toward the Akashi Novice and asked him to play.

units.source_text: 明石道人果然弹得非常出色，迥异凡响。

en.t: The Akashi Novice did indeed play superbly, with a sound far beyond the ordinary.

units.source_text: 今世失传的技法，他都熟悉，手法也都照古风。

en.t: He knew even techniques that had been lost in the present age, and his manner of playing followed the old style throughout.

units.source_text: 那左手摇弦而发的音，尤其弹得清澄可听。

en.t: The tones he produced by trembling the strings with his left hand were especially clear, pure, and pleasing to hear.

units.source_text: 这里不是伊势，源氏公子却教嗓子较好的随从者歌唱催马乐《伊势海》，

en.t: Though this was not Ise, Prince Genji had the attendants with the better voices sing the saibara song "The Sea of Ise,"

units.source_text: 其词云：“伊势渚清海潮退，摘海藻欤拾海贝？”

en.t: whose words say, "On Ise's clear shore the tide recedes; shall we gather seaweed, or pick up shells?"

units.source_text: 自己也时时按拍，与他们齐声合唱。

en.t: He himself also kept time now and then and joined his voice with theirs in song.

units.source_text: 明石道人停止了弹筝而赞赏。

en.t: The Akashi Novice stopped playing the koto and expressed his admiration.

units.source_text: 他教人备办种种茶点果品，都极珍贵，又殷勤劝随从诸人饮酒。

en.t: He had various refreshments and fruits prepared, all of them exceedingly rare, and warmly urged the attendants to drink.

units.source_text: 大家几乎忘记了人世忧患，欢度了这一宵。

en.t: Everyone nearly forgot the sorrows of the world and passed that night in pleasure.
